htn_kidney.title: Feasibility and outcomes of kidney transplantation in patients with end-stage kidney disease after haemopoietic stem cell transplantation.
htn_kidney.authors: Kim B, Choi S, Lee H
htn_kidney.zhSummary: 该文聚焦高血压肾病，属于临床研究。核心观点：造血干细胞移植（HSCT）的进步改善了长期生存，但也导致了晚期并发症，例如肾病。 临床提示：然而，HSCT相关终末期肾病（ESKD）患者肾移植（KT）的安全性和可行性仍不清楚。
htn_kidney.abstract: Advances in haemopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT) have improved long-term survival, but they have also led to late complications, such as nephropathy. However, the safety and feasibility of kidney transplantation (KT) in patients with HSCT-related end-stage kidney disease (ESKD) remain unclear. This study aimed to evaluate the feasibility and clinical outcomes of KT in patients with ESKD following HSCT. This study retrospectively analysed eight patients with ESKD who underwent KT following HSCT for haematologic disorders, including aplastic anaemia (n = 5), acute myeloid leukaemia (n = 2) and chronic myeloid leukaemia (n = 1). portal_hypertension.title: Predictive performance of CT-based artificial intelligence for predicting variceal bleeding in portal hypertension: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
portal_hypertension.authors: Zhu C, Liu Q, Tao W
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究（样本量约为 470）。核心观点：系统评估基于计算机断层扫描（CT）的人工智能（AI）预测门脉高压患者静脉曲张出血（VB）的预测准确性，并评估其作为机会性筛查的潜在效用 临床提示：系统评估基于计算机断层扫描（CT）的人工智能（AI）预测门脉高压患者静脉曲张出血（VB）的准确性，并评估其潜力
portal_hypertension.abstract: To systematically evaluate the predictive accuracy of computed tomography (CT)-based artificial intelligence (AI) for predicting variceal bleeding (VB) in patients with portal hypertension, and to assess their potential utility as an opportunistic screening tool alongside Baveno VII criteria. We searched PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, and Cochrane until December 16, 2025, for studies applying radiomics or machine learning algorithms to abdominal CT images for VB prediction. Quality was assessed using PROBAST + AI. A bivariate random-effects model was employed to calculate pooled sensitivity, specificity, and the area under the curve (AUC). portal_hypertension.title: Portal Hypertensive Enteropathy Presenting as Recurrent Large-Volume Urostomy Bleeding.
portal_hypertension.authors: Mullaguri S, Sachdeva M, Al-Roubaie M
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于病例研究。核心观点：一名 58 岁男性，患有膀胱前列腺切除术和回肠导管尿路造口术后患有膀胱癌和前列腺癌、肥胖、慢性肾脏病、代谢功能障碍以及与酒精相关的肝病相关的肝硬化，多次入院治疗 临床提示：一名 58 岁男性，在膀胱前列腺切除术和回肠导管尿路造口术后患有膀胱癌和前列腺癌、肥胖、慢性肾脏病、代谢功能障碍和酒精相关肝病相关肝硬化
portal_hypertension.abstract: Portal hypertension usually manifests with gastroesophageal varices, portal hypertensive gastropathy, ascites, and hepatic encephalopathy. Although stomal varices have been described in colostomies, ileostomies, and urostomies, bleeding portal hypertensive enteropathy (PHE) involving an ileal conduit urostomy is previously unreported. A 58-year-old man with bladder and prostate cancer status post-cystoprostatectomy with ileal conduit urostomy, obesity, chronic kidney disease, and metabolic dysfunction and alcohol-associated liver disease-related cirrhosis presented with multiple admissions for recurrent gross hematuria via urostomy secondary to stomal bleeding and anemia.
